title: carex polygama var. heterostachya

It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Carex polygama var. heterostachya include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and reduce oxidative stress.
